role: Armor pieces: the armor type, damage reduction, render index and ArmorMaterial (durability, per-slot reduction, enchantability, repair item), the equip-on-right-click, the leather colour NBT and the dispenser behavior that armors a nearby entity.

members.name: statics: maxDamageArray, CLOTH_OVERLAY_NAMES, EMPTY_SLOT_NAMES, dispenserBehavior
members.note: maxDamageArray and the material table are the generated ITEMS rows; the overlay and slot names are client icons; the dispenser behaviour needs a powered dispenser (world.conf redstone = off).

members.name: armorType, damageReduceAmount, renderIndex, material, overlayIcon, emptySlotIcon
members.note: armor_type and damage_reduce are ITEMS fields; renderIndex and the icons are the armour renderer's (raster_mobs.c) and the slot backgrounds'.

members.name: ItemArmor
members.note: the generated rows carry durability (maxDamageArray * factor) and damageReduceAmount per slot

members.name: getColorFromItemStack
members.note: client colour; leather dyeing's NBT colour is kept in crafting.c only as the recipe result

members.name: getItemEnchantability
members.note: the five armor sets' enchantability is listed per item id in enchant.c

members.name: getArmorMaterial
members.note: Only the per-item rows read it (enchantability, repair, leather dye); no material object is needed.

members.name: removeColor
members.note: the cauldron wash (survival.c) keeps the display compound

members.name: func_82813_b
members.note: the dye recipe (crafting.c:armor_set_color) and dev stacks

members.name: onItemRightClick
members.note: The piece goes on an empty armour slot on both sides (armor_right_click, lane/playfuzz); pf-armor-g29 replays it.

members.name: ArmorMaterial enum: CLOTH, CHAIN, IRON, GOLD, DIAMOND with getDurability, getDamageReductionAmount, getEnchantability, func_151685_b
members.note: folded into the generated per-item rows (durability and reduction) and enchant.c's enchantability table

members.name: ItemArmor$ArmorMaterial.func_151685_b
members.note: n/a: the repair item: only getIsRepairable asks, and only ContainerRepair calls that (anvil = off)

members.name: ItemArmor$1.dispenseStack
members.note: n/a: the dispenser behavior for armor; no dispenser fires (redstone = off)

notes: surv2-block-armor-s1 gates a worn iron chestplate reducing a zombie hit and the helmet breaking at t123 (damage_armor); cat-wear-s1 covers wearing. lane/idxblocks: the dispenser auto-equip is the redstone switch; the right-click equip is pf-armor-g29.
